products.name: Vitamin C Brightening Moisturizer
products.subtitle: Vitamin C Brightening Moisturizer is a gentle daily-use cream that keeps the skin hydrated, smooth, and radiant. Its non-sticky formula absorbs quickly into the skin and helps reduce dryness while giving a fresh and healthy appearance. Perfect for morning and evening skincare routines.
